title: johnstonella angustifolia
intro: Johnstonella angustifolia, commonly known as narrow-leaved Johnstonella, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae) that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and it is used to support digestive health and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Johnstonella angustifolia are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
